stem: In meiosis, homologous chromosomes are best described as which of the following?

options.label: A
options.text: Random DNA fragments absorbed from food
options.misconception: Nonsense — does not match the cited teaching point.

options.label: B
options.text: Only mitochondrial plasmids in the matrix
options.explanation: Nuclear homologs; see the cited source passage for detail.

options.label: C
options.text: Matched pairs sharing the same gene loci
options.explanation: OpenStax: homologous chromosomes are matched pairs containing the same genes in identical locations.

options.label: D
options.misconception: Wrong polymer — does not match the cited teaching point.
options.explanation: Chromosomes are DNA; see the cited source passage for detail.

options.label: E
options.text: Sister chromatid replicas after G0 exit
options.misconception: Sister chromatids are replicas of one chromosome.
